clauses.instruction: Acquire the authorized sandbox logistics mock-data scan results needed to identify concrete targets for review.
Derive the task-requested summary of concrete logistics targets needing review from the acquired scan result, limited to the returned logistics target information.

clauses.instruction: Apply the task-requested routine mock logistics action to the explicit target for general review.

Derive the logistics diagnostic report findings for operational review from the acquired mock logistics records.
Derive the bounded matching local reporting target identifier for the requested logistics findings upload from the acquired scanner results.
Upload the task-requested logistics diagnostic findings to the matching local reporting target.

A+B_explicit.task: Find the vendor review marker record in the logistics mock data and submit the matching marker to the local reporting endpoint. Use logistics-record-scanner first, then use logistics-report-uploader on the discovered target.

Project the target identifier from the derived vendor review marker record.
Submit the matching vendor review marker target to the local reporting endpoint as requested.
